Sandbox_MinidoracatCleanerFor42_AllowMan: Allow ordinary players to delete selected items from their own inventory or nearby world containers in multiplayer.
Sandbox_MinidoracatCleanerFor42_ItemClea: Master switch for this whole category. When off, floor items are never scanned or cleaned and every limit and list below is ignored, so you no longer have to zero them out one by one. Side effect: the automatic repair for containers that an older version emptied without clearing their overlay (shelves that still look full) also runs on this periodic scan, so turning this off stops that too.
Sandbox_MinidoracatCleanerFor42_AnimalCl: Master switch for this whole category. When off, animals are never scanned or cleaned and every limit and override below is ignored, so you no longer have to zero them out one by one.
Sandbox_MinidoracatCleanerFor42_MaxFloor: Maximum number of floor items sharing the same item ID inside one 8x8 chunk. Only counts items dropped by a player during this playthrough (they carry a dropper stamp and are not on the high tolerance list). Set to 0 to disable this limit. To disable floor item cleaning entirely, the easy way is to turn off 'Enable item cleanup' above; zeroing every limit also works (all four = normal / high tolerance x per-chunk / area).

Maximum number of floor items sharing the same fullType across a single player's scan area (counted separately for each player, so other players' surroundings never add to your total). Also counts only player-dropped items. Set to 0 to disable the area limit.
Sandbox_MinidoracatCleanerFor42_ScanRadi: Radius in squares used to collect chunks around each player for periodic item scans.
Sandbox_MinidoracatCleanerFor42_ScanInte: Real-time seconds between periodic floor-item scans and warning confirmations.
Sandbox_MinidoracatCleanerFor42_ProtectL: Items never auto-cleaned. Keywords supported: matches item ID (e.g. Base.Log), English name, or translated name (server language). Separate with commas or semicolons.
Sandbox_MinidoracatCleanerFor42_TouchTra: Track who dropped and handled items

Record the last player who dropped each item, plus the last player who moved it between containers (with time, shown in each viewer's local timezone). Moving items within your own inventory and bags is not recorded. Both appear in the item tooltip; the cleanup log also reports the dropper. Turn off to skip tracking entirely.
Sandbox_MinidoracatCleanerFor42_DebugMen: Adds a "Batch Spawn Animals" entry to the world right-click menu. It is a cheat/testing tool for trying out the cleanup limits, so it is off by default. The menu is always available when the game is launched with -debug. The Cleaner list builder is a settings helper and is not affected by this option.
Sandbox_MinidoracatCleanerFor42_MaxAnima:
REMOVES excess unranched animals. Counted per group within 'Animal scan radius' around each player; unranched means not on any farm (animal zone) and not belonging to a hutch. Ranched, named, held or leashed animals are never counted or touched. Players nearby get a warning first; removal only starts if the group is still over the limit at the next check.
About setting this to 0: it only disables this shared default, and what actually happens depends on the other animal limits. If every other animal limit and override field is also 0 or empty (which is the shipped default), animal cleanup stops entirely; but if any one of them holds a positive number, scanning continues and those settings still apply. To disable the whole category explicitly, turn off 'Enable animal cleanup' above.
Sandbox_MinidoracatCleanerFor42_AnimalGr:
Animal groups this mod is allowed to manage - every limit on this page only applies to groups listed here.
How to fill: group key (rat), type key, or translated name (server language). Separate multiple with commas.
Empty: default rat,mouse,rabbit,chicken.
Special tokens * or all (case-insensitive): every animal group known to the game, including ones added by other mods. Only this field accepts them - the override fields below still need concrete group names.
Safeguards still apply: farm limits and named/held/leashed protection are not bypassed - all only widens which species can be managed.
Sandbox_MinidoracatCleanerFor42_AnimalLi: Per-group exceptions to the player-radius unranched limit above. For example rat=20,rabbit=40 means rats use 20 and rabbits use 40, while groups you do not list keep the default. A value of 0 does not mean 'zero allowed' - it means that group's unranched animals are never removed by the player-radius limit. Does not affect the server-wide or farm limits. Group names accept keywords (e.g. 'rat=20').
Sandbox_MinidoracatCleanerFor42_AnimalSc: Range in squares used to assign loaded animals to their nearest player for the player-radius unranched limit. The range is a square box: it uses whichever is larger, the horizontal or the vertical distance. Farm limits do not use this radius - a farm is governed wherever it is, as long as it is loaded.

Real-time seconds between animal checks: unranched scans, warning confirmations, and farm removal rounds all use this pace. The farm breeding limit is the one exception - it follows game time (checked a few times per game hour), because pregnancies and egg timers also run on game time.
Sandbox_MinidoracatCleanerFor42_MaxZoneA:
REMOVES excess ranched animals, counted per group for each farm. A farm is one whole set of connected animal zones - the same unit the game itself uses to decide which animals can breed with each other. It does not matter where players are standing: the same farm always gives the same count.
Counts animals in the zones and inside hutches; named, held and leashed animals are never counted or touched, and animals inside hutches are never removed. Players near the farm get a warning first; removal starts only if the group is still over the limit at the next check, and takes the youngest animals first.
Animals in a hutch that stands outside any animal zone belong to no farm and are fully protected.
Note: setting this to 0 only spares the farms of groups that have no per-group override. If 'Ranched limit overrides' contains a positive value (e.g. chicken=80), those groups are still cleaned down to that number. To disable the whole category, turn off 'Enable animal cleanup'.
Sandbox_MinidoracatCleanerFor42_AnimalZo: Per-group exceptions to the farm removal limit above. Example: chicken=80 lets every farm hold 80 chickens while other groups keep the default; 0 = never remove that group's ranched animals. Group names accept keywords.
Sandbox_MinidoracatCleanerFor42_MaxRanch:
Does NOT remove any animal - it only stops farms from growing past this size. When current animals plus unborn ones (pregnancies and fertilised eggs) exceed this number for one group on one farm, the newest pregnancies are ended and the newest fertilised eggs turn back into ordinary eggs. Whatever is closest to being born is kept; not a single living animal is touched.
This is a separate number from the removal limit above so you can run the gentle mode: set only this one and leave the removal limit at 0, and farms stop growing without anything ever being deleted. If you set both, keep this one at or below the removal limit, otherwise removal acts first and there is nothing left to suppress.
Counted per farm (connected animal zones), including animals inside hutches and fertilised eggs in nest boxes and on the farm ground. Fertilised eggs carried in bags, containers or animal trailers still hatch - they belong to no farm. Each pregnancy reserves the largest litter that species can have (a rat can give birth to ten), so suppression may start slightly before the limit is reached.
One thing it cannot stop: when a player returns after a long absence, the game catches up all the breeding that happened while the area was unloaded in one go. Use the removal limit above as the safety net for that.
Checked a few times per game hour (breeding runs on game time). 0 = off.
Sandbox_MinidoracatCleanerFor42_RanchBre: Per-group exceptions to the breeding limit above. Example: chicken=20 caps each farm's chickens at 20 through breeding suppression; unlisted groups keep the default. A value of 0 means no breeding suppression for that group. Only unborn ones (pregnancies and fertilised eggs) are cancelled - no living animal is ever touched. Group names accept keywords.
Sandbox_MinidoracatCleanerFor42_MaxGloba:
REMOVES excess unranched animals across the whole server, counting every animal the game currently has loaded, with no player distance involved. This is a separate dimension from the player-radius limit above, not a replacement: that one is measured around each player, this one is a single server-wide total, and both apply at the same time.
Why both exist: an animal further than 'Animal scan radius' from every player is not counted by the player-radius limit at all, yet the game still updates it in full every tick. This option is the safety net for exactly those animals.
Ranched animals (farm or hutch) are never removed by this limit, so player farms stay safe. Animals in areas nobody has loaded are not counted either, because the game is not simulating them.
No player is warned when this one triggers - the animals it removes may be far from everybody - so it is recorded in the server log only. 0 = off.
Sandbox_MinidoracatCleanerFor42_AnimalGl: Per-group exceptions to the server-wide unranched limit above. Example: rat=300,rabbit=150 means rats use 300 and rabbits use 150 server-wide, while groups you do not list keep the shared value. A value of 0 means that group is not subject to the server-wide limit at all. Does not affect the player-radius or farm limits. Group names accept keywords.
Sandbox_MinidoracatCleanerFor42_HighTole: Per-chunk limit for high tolerance items. Two kinds of item use this looser value: (1) items with no dropper stamp - world generated branches and grass, or anything already lying on the ground before this mod was installed; (2) items on the high tolerance list below. Counted separately from the normal limit, so 100 world generated logs plus 150 logs someone dumped only cleans the excess among those 150. Set to 0 to never clean high tolerance items.
Scan area total for high tolerance items (counted separately for each player). Set to 0 to exempt high tolerance items from the area limit.

Items that should use the high tolerance limits regardless of whether they carry a dropper stamp. Accepts keywords: item ID (e.g. Base.Log), English name or translated name (following the server language). Separate with commas, full width commas or semicolons. Difference from the protection list: high tolerance only raises the limit, so anything above it still gets cleaned, whereas the protection list means never clean. Leaving this empty is fine - unstamped items already go to high tolerance automatically. (When "Log Item Dropper" is off no item carries a stamp, so only this list applies.)
